summary.text: Martha Lawley is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 27, serving since January 2023, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Martha Lawley was born in Lake Charles, Louisiana, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Wyoming in 1978 and a J.D. from Baylor Law School in 1981.
Lawley's career experience includes working as an attorney.
Lawley assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 2, 2023, succeeding Mike Greear.
For 2025-2026, Lawley's committee assignments include the House Education Committee, the House Minerals, Business and Economic Development Committee and the Select Water Committee.
